money: raw integer strings, six decimals; settings in the household profile's own units
about: A mortgage-free household issues against its insured asset and keeps the BUCK, depositing them in the basket. The carry line needs no market move; the premium needs the BUCK dear against the basket (the same share of every TOKEN pool bought, and the basket's TWAP). Read by the Python and JavaScript suites.

premium.about: no carry line and no closing fee: the household holds until the BUCK is dear by more than issue_premium after the fee

programme.about: pure vectors: one bite of a line against the whole line; the closing cost is allocated by dollars

flow.about: one real investment per case; refused = the same send with one bound made unreachable, so the contract itself reverts. Cases marked js: false run in Python only, to bound the Tevm run; the JavaScript set still covers every phase and every outcome kind.

cases.name: lost closing reply is applied once
lost reserve purchase is applied once
refused reserve purchase keeps the closing paid once
lost issuance reply is applied once
refused issuance keeps the reserve and reissues later
unavailable issuance quote waits and sends nothing twice
lost deposit reply is booked once
refused deposit retries only the deposit
unavailable deposit quote retries only the deposit
